text_block_list.text:
"Startled by a tremendous sound, I rushed over
only to find Hishi Amazon headbutting a tree in the plaza."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's you, Trainy.
Just getting myself fired back up a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Earlier this morning, someone asked me,
'Big sis... are you tired lately?' or something like that..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, making my juniors worry about me...
How pathetic can I get!

Hishi Amazon certainly looks exhausted.
It might be best to reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
